title: Finite reduction respects the inverse-image square
statement: For an adic coefficient datum d and chosen cartesian square sq [def-weil-pbc-four-corners], fix a coefficient level n and M in D(A_Y). The four normalized finite reduction/pullback isomorphisms χ commute with the integral and finite canonical ambient inverse-image squares. Explicitly χ_g then χ_f′ then reduction of the integral square equals the finite square then χ_f then χ_g′, with whiskering as in the Lean signature. No properness, completeness, or etale-origin hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary restriction pullback square to the integral and quotient ringed coefficient systems. Invert its geometric compositors and localize its exact functors.
Take mates under the derived extension/restriction adjunctions. Naturality of mates gives the reduction square, and ambientSquare_localization identifies its exact and canonical geometric faces.
Specialize to the four completed coefficient projections d.projection. Their compatibility is d.projection_comm. The defined finite χ is the resulting normalized mate.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteReductionPullback_square
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g) (n : ℕ) (M : d.derived Y) :
    (d.finitePull f' n).map ((d.chi g n).hom.app M) ≫
      (d.chi f' n).hom.app ((d.pull g).obj M) ≫
      (d.reduction X' n).map
        ((proEtaleAmbientRingedPullbackComparison sq
          (d.completedRing X) (d.completedRing Y)
          (d.completedRing X') (d.completedRing Y')
          (d.integralRingIso f) (d.integralRingIso g)
          (d.integralRingIso g') (d.integralRingIso f')
          (d.integral_coherent sq)).hom.app M) =
    (proEtaleAmbientRingedPullbackComparison sq
        (d.finiteRing X n) (d.finiteRing Y n)
        (d.finiteRing X' n) (d.finiteRing Y' n)
        (d.finiteRingIso f n) (d.finiteRingIso g n)
        (d.finiteRingIso g' n) (d.finiteRingIso f' n)
        (d.finite_coherent sq n)).hom.app ((d.reduction Y n).obj M) ≫
      (d.finitePull g' n).map ((d.chi f n).hom.app M) ≫
      (d.chi g' n).hom.app ((d.pull f).obj M)
